{{recipe}}

{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=12|time=60 minutes|difficulty=2
| Image = [[File:A slice of bread pudding.JPG|300px]]
}}
==Ingredients==
* 6 slices of [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]], with or without crusts. Slightly stale or new bread is acceptable.
* 30 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* 80 g (½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]] (optional)
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 150 g (¾ cup) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 475 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (2 cups) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 2 g (1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]]) ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 5 ml (1 tsp) [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]]

==Equipment==
* 20 cm (8-inch) square baking pan, or large oven-safe bowl
* Mixing bowl
* [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]]

==Procedure==
# Heat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 175°C (350°F).
# Rip bread into small pieces. Cutting into cubes is also okay. Place into baking dish. Mix in raisins while filling the dish.
# Pour melted butter over the bread.
# In a bowl, beat the eggs slightly. Add the sugar, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla. Mix.
# Pour mixture over the bread. Press the bread lightly to help it absorb the mixture, if necessary. All the bread should be wet.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in preheated oven for 45 minutes.
# Remove and let cool.
# Serve cold, though warm may also be acceptable. Use a spoon, or cut into squares, to serve.
